purpose: Verify that source-qualified V5 remains operational across both development worlds and all three frozen checkpoints before the 30-case corrective matrix.

approval.scope: One immutable six-case V5 readiness run after the combined live probe seals.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed full-paper scope.

sampling.independent_units: Two development worlds at environment seed 11; checkpoint seeds quantify model variation and are not independent worlds.

method.main: V9 structural semantics with V5 verified re-anchor and frontier execution feedback; all simulator, sensor, terrain, local planner and controller components remain frozen.
method.baseline: The earlier sealed V9 readiness proves the unchanged sensor/model interface; this run qualifies only the new graph correction.
method.fallback: Existing frozen B0 direction fallback only; no new fallback or weight.
method.thresholds: Per case: travel >=5m, nodes >=2, verified edges >=1, at least one non-hold target, zero failed cycles and post-warmup fallback <=5%.

evidence.expected: Six lossless bags, case metrics, V5 traces/snapshots, per-case correction diagnostics, summary, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.pass: All six fixed cases pass every readiness and storage gate with exact V5/V3 identities and zero forbidden operations.
evidence.fail: Any source/tool/image/checkpoint drift, case failure, fallback excess, archive failure or forbidden read.

estimated_cost.compute: Six serial 180-second CPU/Gazebo inference cases; zero training and zero GPU requirement.
